# SciTech Central

> > A multidisciplinary open access publishing platform providing peer-reviewed journals, article discovery, and international academic community access across medical, scientific, and engineering disciplines.

SciTech Central operates as a comprehensive open access journal portal compliant with Bethesda Statement standards and Creative Commons licensing. The platform serves researchers, clinicians, and academics by offering subject-based journal browsing, article directories, membership programs, and editorial leadership across diverse research fields.

## Key Topics

- Open Access Journals
- Academic Publishing

## Journal Discovery & Browsing

- [Open Access Journals Directory](https://scitcentral.com/openAccess): Open access journals directory published by SciTech Central across multiple disciplines
- [A-to-Z Journal Listing](https://scitcentral.com/atozJournals): A-to-Z directory of SciTech Central's open access journals across medical and engineering fields
- [Browse Journals by Subject](https://scitcentral.com/browseBySubject): Subject-wise browsing interface for multidisciplinary open access journals
- [Journal of Astronomy and Space Research](https://scitcentral.com/journals.php): Journal showcase featuring astronomy, space research, and related peer-reviewed publications

## Research Articles & Publications

- [Article Directory](https://scitcentral.com/articleLinks): Article directory featuring biomedical research, microbiology, and rheumatology publications
- [Article Directory (PHP)](https://scitcentral.com/articleLinks.php): Article directory for peer-reviewed biomedical and scientific research publications
- [Latest Updates](https://scitcentral.com/latestupdates.php): Latest updates featuring editorial testimonials and recent journal publications

## Editorial Leadership & Governance

- [Editors-in-Chief Directory](https://scitcentral.com/editorChief): Editors-in-Chief directory for SciTech Central's open access journal publications
- [Editors-in-Chief Directory (PHP)](https://scitcentral.com/editorCheif.php): Editors-in-Chief directory for SciTech Central's open access journal portfolio

## Membership & Community

- [International Membership Program](https://scitcentral.com/membership): International membership program offering access to journals, conferences, and e-books
- [International Membership Program (PHP)](https://scitcentral.com/membership.php): International membership access to journals, conferences, e-books, and scientific community

## Support & Information

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://scitcentral.com/faq): FAQ covering open access publishing, submission guidelines, and journal policies
